theme: process privilege EUID/ISROOT + PPID/PGID/SID lineage + SHELL

tests.name: gate_noroot
tests.cmd: HAS false friend noroot soft deny

weaknesses.title: ISROOT is always OK=1 probe bit — no soft-fail semantic
weaknesses.detail: Unlike ATIME miss OK=0, ISROOT never fails; agents must branch LAST_N. Easy to ASSERT OK and think privileged.

weaknesses.title: No SETEUID/SETUID — can probe but not drop privilege in-language
weaknesses.detail: Agents that detect root cannot demote before untrusted plate work without SPAWN/external helper.

weaknesses.title: PPID/PGID/SID are numbers only — no parent cmdline/comm stamp
weaknesses.detail: Cannot answer who spawned me without /proc read. No PARENT_COMM / EXE form.

weaknesses.title: Gate mode parsing via HAS is false-friend prone (noroot contains root)
weaknesses.detail: HAS noroot root → 1. Board hand-rolls no-prefix. EQS-only safer but agents invent aliases with HAS.

weaknesses.title: SHELL source ($SHELL vs passwd) not distinguished
weaknesses.detail: Agents cannot tell env override from login shell. Empty SHELL edge host-dependent.

weaknesses.title: UID vs EUID dual under-documented for setuid cubalc
weaknesses.detail: same action is the only agent-facing dual check; OWNEDBY uses euid only.

weaknesses.title: WRITE metas omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: VAL short stamps glue in cat -A.

workarounds: Branch ISROOT on LAST_N not OK
Prefer EQS gate modes root|user over HAS
Stamp PPID for audit; resolve parent out-of-band if needed
language_gaps: ISROOT soft-fail option or REQUIRE ROOT form
issues_faced: gate user REQUIRE denies; noroot HAS false friend documented
